pages.name: Ghoul
pages.text: Гуль — Ghoul. A hunched carrion eater with long, heavy forelimbs.

pages.title: Habitat
pages.text: The Overworld: dark areas, nights and caves. May spawn in groups.

pages.title: Behavior
pages.text: Closes the distance quickly, leaps toward its target and strikes with claws.

pages.title: Weaknesses
pages.text: Necrophage elixir: +25 percent. Necrophage oil: +15 percent for 40 successful hits.

pages.title: Loot
pages.text: Ghoul essence, claw and trophy head.

pages.title: Hunter’s advice
pages.text: Leave space to evade its leap. Do not let a pack surround you.
